blocks.text: Predicate logic propositional logic ki tausee (extension) hai. Yeh ashya aur un ki sifaat ke baare mein zyada tafseeli statements bayan karne, aur afraad, groups aur un ke rishton ki baat karne deti hai (Fig 2.7).

blocks.alt: Box Predicate: Helps, jis se teer do boxes tak jate hain, Variable: x aur Variable: y; neeche Helps (x, y) likha hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 2.7: Predicate logic ki banawat (kitab ki Figure 2.7 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Predicate
blocks.text: Predicate aisa statement hai jo apne variables ki qeematon ke mutabiq sach ya jhoot ho sakta hai; yeh kisi cheez ki sifat ya cheezon ke darmiyan rishta bayan karta hai.

Maslan 'x 5 se bara hai' predicate hai kyunke is ki sachai x par munhasir hai. Predicate logic 'Tamam talaba mehnati hain' ya 'Kuch kitabein dilchasp hain' jaise statements bayan kar sakti hai, is liye ilm ko rasmi tareeqe se pesh karne ke liye use hoti hai.
Propositional aur predicate logic ka muwazna

blocks.caption: Propositional logic aur predicate logic
rows: Poore statements jo sach ya jhoot hon
Ashya, un ki sifaat aur rishte, predicates aur variables se
A = 'Ali lamba hai' (A ke andar nahi dekh sakte)
Tall(Ali): mozoo Ali aur sifat Tall
Zyada bayan karne wali aur lachakdar; bohat si ashya aur shartein

blocks.text: Predicates ashya ki sifaat ya rishte bayan karte hain; maslan isEven(x) sach hai agar x jufat number ho, aur Helps(x, y) ka matlab 'x y ki madad karta hai' ho sakta hai. Variables domain of discourse (jin cheezon ki baat ho rahi hai un ka set) ki ashya ya qeematon ki numaindagi karte hain. Variables se hum 'tamam x ke liye, x > 0' jaise aam statements likh sakte hain. Predicates aur variables mil kar predicate logic ke expressions banate hain jo pecheeda khayalat wazeh aur rasmi tareeqe se bayan karte hain.

blocks.prompt: 'Sara talib-e-ilm hai' aur 'Sara ko cricket pasand hai' predicates se likhein. Propositional logic kyun nahi dikha sakti ke dono Sara ke baare mein hain?
blocks.explanation: Student(Sara) aur Likes(Sara, cricket). Propositional logic mein yeh P aur Q jaise do be-talluq harf hote jo mozoo chhupa dete, is liye mushtarka mozoo Sara na dikhta na us par istidlal hota.
